question: For veg whsle data, can you generate a summary of our items' loss rates? Include the average loss rate, and also break down the count of items that are below, above, and within one standard deviation from this average.
sql:
WITH stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG("loss_rate_%") AS avg_loss,
    STDDEV("loss_rate_%") AS std_dev
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
enriched AS (
  SELECT v."loss_rate_%", s.avg_loss, s.std_dev
  FROM veg_loss_rate_df v, stats s
)
SELECT 
  ANY_VALUE(avg_loss) AS average_loss_rate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" < avg_loss - std_dev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS below_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" >= avg_loss - std_dev AND "loss_rate_%" <= avg_loss + std_dev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN "loss_rate_%" > avg_loss + std_dev THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_count
FROM enriched
